title: EU-27 national digital readiness benchmark
source: Project EU27 Digital Readiness panel based on official Eurostat indicators
benchmark_scope: Indicator-level national benchmark; not a composite digital competitiveness ranking.

indicators.label: Лица с поне базови дигитални умения
ИКТ специалисти като дял от заетостта
МСП с поне базово равнище на цифров интензитет
Население с висше образование, 25 до 64 г.

methodology.eu_aggregate: EU27_2020 / EU_27 is the official EU aggregate supplied in the project panel, not a simple mean of member states.
methodology.missing_values: null means missing or unavailable and is never replaced by zero.
methodology.comparability: Comparisons are made by the same indicator and year. Methodological breaks remain visible.
methodology.dii: The national panel uses comparable DII waves selected in the project dataset; DII versions should not be mechanically mixed outside this benchmark.
methodology.ranking: Country positions are indicator-specific and include only EU member states with a valid value. The EU aggregate is not ranked.
